title: servers.emoji_created
description: EmojiCreated is published by servers when a custom emoji is added to a server. Like EmojiDeleted, it carries the whole emoji: an emoji never changes after it is created, so its only transition is being deleted, and that transition wins whatever order the two events arrive in.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

animated.description: true si la imagen es un GIF; usarlo requiere Premium.
